## About
Century Collision Repair and Refinishing was founded by Robert Dittert, a Master Repair and Refinishing technician who is ICAR Gold Class and ASE certified. We specialize in collision damage, and we handle a lot more than that: frame and unibody work, rust repairs, painting and color matching, welding, glass and accessories.
We want you to know exactly what is happening to your car. Everything we do will be explained to you in plain terms, and we use PPG paint. Our goal is good work at a fair price without wasting your time.
Customers know us by name. Reviewers mention John and Bob by name, and we're rated 5 from 42 Google reviews.

## Services
- Collision repairs: Collision damage is what we specialize in.
- Complete full frame and unibody repair: Structural repair to get your vehicle back to where it should be.
- Expert painting and color matching: Paint and refinishing matched to your car's color.
- Insurance claims assistance: We help you through the insurance claim.
- Rust repairs: Rust repair, including structural work on the undercarriage, as one reviewer needed to pass PA State Inspection.
- Welding (steel and aluminum): Welding on steel and aluminum panels and parts.
- Auto glass replacement, new and used: Replacement auto glass, new or used.
- Free estimates: Free estimates on all collision work.

## FAQ
Q: Do you help with insurance claims?
A: Yes. We offer insurance claims assistance.

Q: Do estimates cost anything?
A: No. Estimates on all collision work are free.

Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We handle both foreign and domestic auto repair.

Q: Can I come in on a Saturday?
A: Saturday is by appointment only, so give us a call first.
